RNN6rbB5tzh7Ip3eH-1Qpw.zh: 斯里蘭卡今年截至7/30累計報告84,724例病例,其中62例死亡(CFR: 0.07%),其中7月報告約2.9萬例,疫情集中於加姆珀哈區(Gampaha District),以第二型(DENV-2)血清型傳播力為高。近一週病例數雖下降3%,惟住院數仍高,當局已增加登革熱高風險告警區域。 泰國今年截至第30週(8/1)累計報告1萬7,299例病例,病患多介於10-19歲,死亡率最高的年齡層為40-49歲及60歲以上,疫情低於預測且低於去年同期。 菲律賓宿霧(Cebu)今年截至7/18累計報告1228例病例,其中10 例死亡,病例數較去年同期增加12.35%;另三寶顏市(Zamboanga)今年截至7/25累計報告1,184例,疫情較去年同期增加20%,其中11例死亡(多為10歲以下兒童)。
RNN6rbB5tzh7Ip3eH-1Qpw.en: Sri Lanka has reported 84,724 dengue cases cumulatively this year up to 30 July, including 62 deaths (CFR: 0.07%). About 29,000 cases were reported in July alone. The outbreak is concentrated in Gampaha District, where transmission of DENV-2 serotype is high. Although cases fell 3% over the past week, hospitalizations remain high, and authorities have expanded high-risk dengue alert areas. Thailand has reported 17,299 cases cumulatively this year as of week 30 (1 August), mostly among people aged 10–19 years. The highest mortality is among those aged 40–49 years and 60 years and above. Cases are below forecasts and lower than the same period last year. In the Philippines, Cebu has reported 1,228 cases cumulatively as of 18 July, including 10 deaths, a 12.35% increase over the same period last year. Zamboanga City has reported 1,184 cases cumulatively as of 25 July, a 20% increase over the same period last year, including 11 deaths, mostly among children under 10 years.

oNFy6vx7GKnFUDLGZGmBlA.zh: 巴西東南部米納斯吉拉斯州(Minas Gerais )今年截至6/22累積報告6萬4,304例極可能病例,其中3萬6,517確診、32例死亡並有39例死亡案例仍調查中。另巴西全國今年迄今累計報告逾41萬例疑病例 ,246 例死亡 。 斯里蘭卡疫情嚴峻,今年截至7/11累計報告逾6萬7,200例病例,其中47例死亡,近期住院數從每週700餘例增加至1,000餘例,醫療量能已不堪負荷,專家推估實際感染人數可能接近20萬人,公共衛生資源嚴重不足為導致大規模疫情之主因。
oNFy6vx7GKnFUDLGZGmBlA.en: In Minas Gerais State in southeastern Brazil, 64,304 probable cases have been reported cumulatively as of 22 June this year, including 36,517 confirmed cases and 32 deaths, with 39 death cases still under investigation. Nationwide, Brazil has reported more than 410,000 suspected cases cumulatively this year, including 246 deaths. Sri Lanka's outbreak is severe. As of 11 July this year, more than 67,200 cases have been reported cumulatively, including 47 deaths. Weekly hospitalizations have risen from over 700 to more than 1,000. Health care capacity is overwhelmed, and experts estimate the actual number of infections may be close to 200,000. A serious shortage of public health resources is the main cause of this large-scale outbreak.

TbXnWKLSy3clwJ-s5nt2OQ.zh: 斯里蘭卡疫情上升,近1週(6/15-21)新增5,267例疑病例,今年截至6/27累計報告52,068例病例,病例主要分布於西部省的可倫坡及加姆珀哈區分別為10,839及10,113例,該國6月迄今已報告18,227例(占今年病例數的35%)。 孟加拉疫情更新,近1週新增約1千例病例,今年迄今累計報告5,800例病例,主要分布於巴里薩爾及吉大港區,該國6月截至6/28已報告2,603例(占今年病例數的45%)。
TbXnWKLSy3clwJ-s5nt2OQ.en: Sri Lanka's outbreak is rising. In the past week (15–21 June), 5,267 suspected cases were added, and this year as of 27 June, 52,068 cases have been reported cumulatively. Cases are mainly in the Western Province, with 10,839 in Colombo and 10,113 in Gampaha District. Sri Lanka has reported 18,227 cases so far in June, 35% of this year's total. Bangladesh's outbreak update: about 1,000 new cases were added in the past week, and 5,800 cases have been reported cumulatively this year, mainly in the Barisal and Chattogram divisions. Bangladesh reported 2,603 cases in June through 28 June, 45% of this year's total.

5LCj5sh_yKEDTVx1i_ge2A.zh: 越南疫情上升,今年1-5月累計報告逾50,000例病例,約為去年同期病例數的2.5倍,疫情時間較往年提早,病例發生不再局限於特定地區、季節或年齡層,該國大部分地區皆有報告病例,包含過去較少報告病例的北部地區,目前主要流行型別為DENV-2。 斯里蘭卡疫情上升,今年截至6/5累計報告36,168例病例,病例數較去年同期增加約1萬例,近50%病例分布於西部省,另有20例相關死亡病例,其中包括 3 例兒童死亡病例。當局已啟動預防控制計畫。
5LCj5sh_yKEDTVx1i_ge2A.en: Viet Nam's outbreak is rising. Between January and May this year, more than 50,000 cases were reported cumulatively, about 2.5 times the same period last year. The outbreak started earlier than usual, and cases are no longer confined to specific regions, seasons or age groups. Most parts of the country have reported cases, including the northern region, which previously reported few cases. The main circulating serotype is DENV-2. Sri Lanka's outbreak is rising. As of 5 June this year, 36,168 cases have been reported cumulatively, about 10,000 more than the same period last year. Nearly 50% of cases are in the Western Province, and 20 related deaths have been recorded, including 3 child deaths. Authorities have launched a prevention and control plan.

sHyQYSPlEWl1olIXgfWgvg.zh: 越南胡志明市疫情更新,近1週(5/11-17)報告414例病例,較前4週平均數下降,2026年截至第20週累計報告16,892例病例,高於2025年同期。 斯里蘭卡疫情更新,2026年截至5/18累計報告29,589例病例及15例死亡,病例分布於該國25個行政區。
sHyQYSPlEWl1olIXgfWgvg.en: Ho Chi Minh City, Viet Nam: in the most recent week (11–17 May), 414 cases were reported, lower than the average of the previous four weeks. Cumulatively, 16,892 cases were reported up to week 20 of 2026, higher than in the same period of 2025. Sri Lanka outbreak update: as of 18 May 2026, 29,589 cases and 15 deaths had been reported cumulatively, distributed across 25 administrative districts of the country.

hCJEg7XJmotPlDCwX_TxkQ.zh: 越南胡志明市疫情上升,今年截至第19週累計報告逾16,000例病例,較去年同期上升70%以上。 斯里蘭卡疫情上升,今年截至5/11累計報告27,754例病例及14例死亡,病例數高於去年同期,以西部省病例數最多。
hCJEg7XJmotPlDCwX_TxkQ.en: Ho Chi Minh City, Viet Nam: the outbreak is rising, with more than 16,000 cases reported cumulatively this year as of week 19, up more than 70% from the same period last year. Sri Lanka: the outbreak is rising, with 27,754 cases and 14 deaths reported cumulatively this year as of 11 May. Case numbers are higher than in the same period last year, and the Western Province has the most cases.

LRV312LCVUhs1ayg4X5jgA.zh: 越南胡志明市疫情持續攀升,今年截至5/3累計報告1萬5,104例病例,其中5例死亡,4月新增5,243例,較3月病例數增加1.6倍,且較去(2025)年同期增加1倍。 斯里蘭卡南部馬塔拉區(Matara)德亞亞地區(Deniyaya)截至5/12報告近50例疑病例,其中5例經實驗室確診為腸病毒腦膜炎,病患多為14-15歲的學童,當局已發布停課通知並加強監測等防治措施。
LRV312LCVUhs1ayg4X5jgA.en: Ho Chi Minh City, Viet Nam, continues to see rising cases: as of 3 May this year, 15,104 cases had been reported cumulatively, including five deaths. There were 5,243 new cases in April, an increase of 1.6 times over March and of 100% over the same period last year. In Deniyaya, in Matara District of southern Sri Lanka, nearly 50 suspected cases had been reported as of 12 May; five were laboratory-confirmed as enterovirus meningitis. Most patients are schoolchildren aged 14–15. Authorities have issued school suspension notices and strengthened surveillance and other control measures.

mbmU-nEo17B36VN_rIkyyw.zh: 斯里蘭卡疫情持續,今年1-2月累計報告13,416例病例及4例死亡,主要分布於西部省,近年來該省病例數約占全國41.8-49%,係因人口密度較高且環境適於病媒蚊孳生,該國流行4種型別,隨著年度及地區而有變動。
mbmU-nEo17B36VN_rIkyyw.en: Dengue in Sri Lanka continues. From January to February this year, 13,416 cases and 4 deaths have been reported cumulatively, mainly in the Western Province. In recent years, the province has accounted for about 41.8–49% of national cases, due to high population density and an environment favourable to vector mosquito breeding. The country has four circulating serotypes, which vary by year and region.

V5PSDdFdHM21HvIgHPb56Q.zh: 斯里蘭卡今年迄今已報告9,480例病例,以西部省病例數最多,當局評估疫情可能隨季風季節上升,並已啟動全國預防及控制措施。
V5PSDdFdHM21HvIgHPb56Q.en: Sri Lanka has reported 9,480 cases so far this year, with the highest number in the Western Province. Authorities assess that the outbreak may rise with the monsoon season, and have launched national prevention and control measures.

6-hpQ5DV6JwMtrPFFgjfCA.zh: 斯里蘭卡疫情上升,2026年迄今已報告2,170例病例(平均每日報告240例病例),2025年累計報告51,479例病例,當局表示由於2025年11月底至12月初洪水造成疫情上升,已加強監測及病媒蚊控制。
6-hpQ5DV6JwMtrPFFgjfCA.en: Sri Lanka's situation is rising. So far in 2026, 2,170 cases have been reported, an average of 240 cases per day. In 2025, 51,479 cases were reported cumulatively. Authorities said the increase followed flooding in late November and early December 2025, and they have strengthened surveillance and vector mosquito control.

CZ_49AJRgiEeT3xPTFR6Vw.zh: 中國廣東省疫情持續,近1週(9/28-10/4)新增3,181例病例,主要分布於江門市2,480例,其次為佛山市、廣州市及肇慶市分別新增100餘例,無報告重症及死亡病例,江門市近期疫情仍處高點波動,由於假期人潮流動、氣候等因素致疫情傳播風險持續增加,當地已啟動突發公共衛生事件三級響應,全力展開防控工作。 全球疫情持續,今年截至9/30累計40國報告445,271例病例及155例死亡,部分國家/地區於今年發生疫情,包括近幾年病例數並不多之國家/地區。全球病例分布以美洲區最多,其中,以巴西疫情最為嚴峻;歐洲區之法國及義大利報告本土病例,法國今年疫情上升與法屬留旺島及印度洋地區疫情有關,法屬留旺島/馬約特島疫情已下降;東南亞區以印度病例數為多,孟加拉、泰國及斯里蘭卡亦報告病例;西太平洋區之中國廣東省截至9/27累計16,452例確診病例,分布於21城市,以佛山市10,032例及江門市5,209例為多,為該國有紀錄以來最大規模疫情,另廣西壯族自治區於9/1-21報告297例,福建省報告124例,其他省份如湖南省、四川省、海南省亦報告病例;非洲區以模里西斯共和國病例數為多;東地中海區之巴基斯坦及索馬利亞亦報告病例。WHO建議加強監測、實驗室及醫療保健能力、病媒監控,以降低疾病進一步傳播風險。
CZ_49AJRgiEeT3xPTFR6Vw.en: Guangdong Province, China: The outbreak continues. In the past week (28 September–4 October), 3,181 new cases were reported, mainly in Jiangmen city (2,480), followed by Foshan, Guangzhou and Zhaoqing, each with more than 100 new cases. No severe or fatal cases were reported. Jiangmen's outbreak remains at a high level with fluctuations. Because of holiday population movement, weather and other factors, transmission risk continues to increase. The area has launched a Level III public health emergency response and is fully carrying out prevention and control work. Globally, the outbreak continues: as of 30 September this year, 40 countries had reported 445,271 cases and 155 deaths cumulatively. Some countries and regions had outbreaks this year, including some that had reported few cases in recent years. The Americas have the most cases globally, with Brazil the most severe. In Europe, France and Italy reported locally acquired cases. France's rise this year is linked to outbreaks in French Réunion and the Indian Ocean area, while the outbreak in French Réunion and Mayotte has declined. In South-East Asia, India has the most cases, and Bangladesh, Thailand and Sri Lanka also reported cases. In the Western Pacific, Guangdong Province, China, had reported 16,452 confirmed cases as of 27 September, distributed across 21 cities, mainly Foshan (10,032) and Jiangmen (5,209), the largest outbreak on record for the country. Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region reported 297 cases from 1 to 21 September, Fujian Province reported 124, and other provinces such as Hunan, Sichuan and Hainan also reported cases. In Africa, Mauritius has the most cases. In the Eastern Mediterranean, Pakistan and Somalia also reported cases. WHO recommends strengthening surveillance, laboratory and healthcare capacity, and vector control to reduce the risk of further spread.

KpXJS-QiaNyZBxaWghEFMg.zh: 全球今年迄今累計報告逾360萬例病例及2,000例死亡,以美洲地區報告逾330萬例病例為多,其中病例主要分布於巴西;今年亞洲地區之印累計89,845例病例、馬來西亞35,348例、斯里蘭卡31,544例、越南28,787例、泰國24,372例及孟加拉20,218例;非洲地區累計10國報告9,266例病例及18例死亡。
KpXJS-QiaNyZBxaWghEFMg.en: Globally, more than 3.6 million cases and 2,000 deaths have been cumulatively reported this year, with the Americas region accounting for more than 3.3 million cases, mainly in Brazil. In Asia this year, Indonesia has cumulatively reported 89,845 cases, Malaysia 35,348, Sri Lanka 31,544, Viet Nam 28,787, Thailand 24,372 and Bangladesh 20,218. In Africa, 10 countries have reported 9,266 cases and 18 deaths cumulatively.

TEEthy_-_aneVY0fNVJGuA.zh: 全球今年迄今累計報告約220,000例病例及80例死亡,分布於美/非/亞洲、法屬留旺島及馬約特島,其中,美洲病例數最多,以巴西141,436例及阿根廷2,521例為多,亞洲之印度、斯里蘭卡及巴基斯坦等國報告逾33,000例,非洲塞內加爾亦有報告病例,另法屬留旺島/馬約特島分別報告逾51,000例及560例,ECDC評估歐洲目前環境愈來愈利於病媒蚊活動,當地疾病傳播風險增加。
TEEthy_-_aneVY0fNVJGuA.en: Globally this year, about 220,000 cases and 80 deaths have been reported cumulatively, in the Americas, Africa and Asia, as well as in the French overseas territories of Réunion and Mayotte. The Americas have the most cases, with Brazil reporting 141,436 and Argentina 2,521. Asian countries including India, Sri Lanka and Pakistan have reported more than 33,000 cases. Senegal in Africa has also reported cases. Réunion and Mayotte have reported more than 51,000 and 560 cases, respectively. ECDC assesses that the environment in Europe is increasingly favorable for vector mosquito activity, and the risk of local transmission is increasing.

gZfhN0GaPgaq8XMr1q4-NQ.zh: 斯里蘭卡疫情更新,今年迄今累計16,500餘例病例,以西部省7,600餘例為最多,其中病例主要分布於該省可倫坡區2,700餘例及加姆珀哈,當局正採取相關預防措施,以避免疫情蔓延。
gZfhN0GaPgaq8XMr1q4-NQ.en: Sri Lanka update: so far this year, more than 16,500 cases have been reported cumulatively, with the Western Province having the most, at more than 7,600. Cases are mainly distributed in Colombo District (more than 2,700) and Gampaha, and authorities are taking preventive measures to prevent the outbreak from spreading.

CpzFOSHHjeXLviR3vu9jsQ.zh: 斯里蘭卡疫情上升,今年迄今累計11,400餘例病例及7例死亡,當局已採取疾病防治計畫;該國2024年累計逾5萬例病例。 印疫情更新,今年截至2/16累計10,700餘例病例及48例死亡;該國2024年累計逾20萬例病例及1,400餘例死亡。
CpzFOSHHjeXLviR3vu9jsQ.en: Dengue activity is rising in Sri Lanka, with over 11,400 cases and 7 deaths reported so far this year. Authorities have implemented a disease prevention and control plan. The country recorded over 50,000 cases in 2024. Indonesia update: as of 16 February this year, over 10,700 cases and 48 deaths have been reported cumulatively; in 2024 the country recorded over 200,000 cases and more than 1,400 deaths.

0KhKPqFgPuM2KNk1BQAeng.zh: 越南胡志明市疫情上升,該市今年迄今累計報告3,400餘例病例,病例數遽增且高於去年同期,預期疫情可能會提早開始。當局已採取預防措施,以控制疫情。 斯里蘭卡疫情更新,今年2/1-4已報告419例病例,今年截至2/3累計報告5,300餘例病例及2例死亡,病例數以西部省2,300餘例最多。 孟加拉疫情更新,最近1天內新增6例病例,今年迄今累計1,500餘例病例及13例死亡,去年累計101,200餘例病例及575例死亡。
0KhKPqFgPuM2KNk1BQAeng.en: Dengue is rising in Ho Chi Minh City, Viet Nam. The city has reported over 3,400 cases so far this year; case numbers have risen sharply and are higher than the same period last year, and the outbreak may start earlier than expected. Authorities have taken preventive measures to control it. Sri Lanka update: 419 cases were reported between 1 and 4 February this year; as of 3 February, over 5,300 cases and 2 deaths have been reported cumulatively this year, with the Western Province accounting for the most, at over 2,300. Bangladesh update: 6 new cases were reported in the last day; so far this year, over 1,500 cases and 13 deaths have been reported, and last year over 101,200 cases and 575 deaths were recorded.

WXGJmVZQRL8HdomhxDUcwg.zh: 斯里蘭卡北部省賈夫納市疫情上升,截至12/16累計報告58例病例,其中8例死亡;該國今年迄今累計報告1.2萬例,約200例死亡。 巴拿馬中部科克萊省今年截至12/7累計報告63例病例,其中1例死亡,當局呼籲民眾接觸汙水,應注意防護措施,並注意防鼠及飲水衛生。
WXGJmVZQRL8HdomhxDUcwg.en: Sri Lanka: Cases are rising in Jaffna municipality in the Northern Province; as of 16 December, 58 cases had been reported cumulatively, including 8 deaths. Sri Lanka has reported 12,000 cases this year cumulatively, with about 200 deaths. Panama: In Coclé Province in central Panama, 63 cases had been reported cumulatively as of 7 December this year, including 1 death. Authorities urge people who come into contact with sewage to take protective measures, and to pay attention to rodent control and drinking-water hygiene.

dgY244_1fSiG-RktJJFG0A.zh: 印疫情更新,今年截至10/19累計203,000餘例病例,其中1,210例死亡。 斯里蘭卡疫情更新,今年迄今累計42,000餘例病例,其中20例死亡。 泊爾疫情更新,今年截至10/25累計27,000餘例病例,其中11例死亡,較去年同期為低。
dgY244_1fSiG-RktJJFG0A.en:
Indonesia update: As of 19 October this year, more than 203,000 cases have been cumulatively reported, including 1,210 deaths.

Sri Lanka update: So far this year, more than 42,000 cases have been cumulatively reported, including 20 deaths.

Nepal update: As of 25 October this year, more than 27,000 cases have been cumulatively reported, including 11 deaths; this is lower than the same period last year.
